description: Neutral prompts for the answer-quality eval (scripts/eval-answers.mjs): 30 in English and 30 in German, three each in French, Spanish, Italian and Turkish. Free prompts ask general knowledge, explanations, short writing and advice; source prompts carry fictitious sample passages and are asked with the app's grounded prompt. 'mention' lists words of which a good answer names at least one (case and accents ignored). Nothing here gates a build.
